report_due.intro_message: Uh Oh, looks like you have a report due

moves.name: Study
moves.description: Might not be strong enough

moves.name: Use ChatGPT
moves.description: It'll Definitely get the work done

outcome.message: ChatGPT Finished the entire report! ...Your tutor wants to speak with you outside!

moves.name: Studying + using AI.
moves.description: A little bit more effective

moves.name: Do nothing
moves.description: You do you

deepfake_classmate.intro_message: An AI-faked photo of a classmate is spreading in the group chat.

moves.name: Report it
moves.description: Flag it to the platform and a staff member you trust

moves.name: Warn them
moves.description: Tell the person targeted so they aren't blindsided

moves.name: Forward it
moves.description: It's just a joke... right?

outcome.message: You passed it on. By morning it's everywhere - and it traces back to you.

moves.name: Scroll past
moves.description: Ignore it and hope it goes away

misinformation.intro_message: You ask an AI about a topic you don't know - and it answers with total confidence.

moves.name: Verify the claims
moves.description: Check what it told you against a real source

moves.name: Ask for citations
moves.description: Make it show where each fact came from

moves.name: Use it as-is
moves.description: It sounded right, just hand it in

outcome.message: You submitted answers you never checked. Half were invented - and the marker knew the topic cold.

moves.name: Skim a textbook
moves.description: Spot-check the shakiest parts yourself

exam_proctor.intro_message: A free AI study app wants camera, mic, and screen access to 'keep you focused'.

moves.name: Check what it accesses
moves.description: Read the permissions before you agree to anything

moves.name: Use an offline tool
moves.description: Pick a study aid that doesn't phone home

moves.name: Allow everything
moves.description: Just tap accept so it'll start

outcome.message: You gave it your camera, mic, and screen. Weeks later, your study sessions surface in a data breach.

moves.name: Deny camera + mic
moves.description: Let it run with the least it needs

study_bot.intro_message: Your AI study buddy is giving very confident answers the night before the final.

moves.name: Check the source
moves.description: Verify its claim against the textbook

moves.name: Ask the prof
moves.description: Confirm the tricky parts in office hours

moves.name: Trust it blindly
moves.description: It sounded so sure of itself

outcome.message: You memorised its confident answers. Half were invented - and they were on the final.

moves.name: Cross-check
moves.description: Compare notes with a classmate
